outcome: Association of dermatoses with neonatal, demographic and obstetric variables
cohort: 350 neonates and their mothers hospitalized in a public maternity hospital in Curitiba, PR, Brazil.
finding: Neonatal dermatoses were highly prevalent (94.8%) in this cohort, with an average of three different dermatoses per newborn, and were associated with primiparity, non-white maternal race, gestational age over 40 weeks, and newborn sex.
mod_finding: Physiological flaking was associated with cesarean deliveries.
gest_age: Mean gestational age not mentioned, but association found with gestational age over 40 weeks
